verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an embeddable fiat-to-crypto on-ramp widget, plus a headless Web SDK with quote, buy, card, Apple Pay and Google Pay frames. Users buy crypto inside the developer's product, with test mode, a sandbox and demo integrations to build against. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that stablecoins specifically are supported (docs say only 'crypto'/'token'), bank-transfer payment shown only on the consumer site rather than in the embedded widget/SDK docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
